{"cells":[{"query":"-- requires downloaded s3 loop json files 
-- populate each plugin of a single json file in a separate row
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE themes_subset as
SELECT
  filename,
  unnest(json.theme) as theme
FROM read_json('/local/s3/2023-11-14/*.json', ignore_errors=1) 
  as json
","cellId":3,"useDatabase":"loop-duckdb","runMode":"default"},{"query":"-- requires downloaded s3 loop json files 
-- populate each plugin of a single json file in a separate row
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE plugins_subset as
SELECT
  filename,
  unnest(json.plugin) as plugin
FROM read_json('/local/s3/2023-11-14/*.json', ignore_errors=1) 
  as json","cellId":4,"useDatabase":"loop-duckdb"},{"query":"-- list of all unique plugins
select distinct plugin.plugin_slug as plugin_slug from plugins;","cellId":5,"useDatabase":"loop-duckdb"},{"query":"-- get occurrence of each plugin   
SELECT 
  plugin.plugin_slug as slug
FROM 
  plugins
WHERE
  NOT slug ILIKE '%ionos%'
;","cellId":6,"useDatabase":"loop-duckdb"},{"query":"-- get (only non ionos) plugin installations by occurence
-- see duckdb-ui sidebar on the right and drill in to sse results
SELECT 
  plugin.plugin_slug as plugin_slug
FROM 
  plugins
WHERE 
  plugin_slug NOT LIKE '%ionos%'","cellId":7,"useDatabase":"loop-duckdb"},{"query":"-- get theme installations by occurence
-- see duckdb-ui sidebar on the right and drill in to sse results
SELECT
  theme.id as slug,
  theme.active as active
FROM themes
WHERE
  active=true
  and (slug LIKE '%elementor%' or slug LIKE '%divi%' or slug LIKE '%block%')
  and slug NOT ILIKE '%child%'
  
;","cellId":8,"useDatabase":"loop-duckdb","isActive":true}],"currentDatabase":"loop-duckdb","viewMode":{"mode":"default"},"version":343,"notebookSerializationFormat":3}

title: S3 JSON data files playground
json:
{"cells":[{"query":"-- list all json files in local/s3 recursive
select * from glob('/local/s3/**/*.json')","cellId":2,"useDatabase":"loop-duckdb"},{"query":"-- list /local contents
select * from glob('/local/*/')","cellId":3,"useDatabase":"loop-duckdb"},{"query":"-- list all loop directories by day
select * from glob('/local/*/*/')","cellId":4,"useDatabase":"loop-duckdb","isActive":true},{"query":"-- query a superset of the json loop files : only query json files in `s3/2023-11-14`
SELECT * FROM read_json('/local/s3/2023-11-14/*.json', ignore_errors=1);
-- `ignore_errors=1` is needed since the json files share not the same schema. 
-- You can try it out without this option to see what happens.","cellId":5,"useDatabase":"loop-duckdb"},{"query":"-- query a superset of the json loop files and have the filename available as additional column
SELECT filename, * FROM read_json('/local/s3/2023-11-14/*.json', ignore_errors=1);","cellId":6,"useDatabase":"loop-duckdb"},{"query":"-- query only a some of the pieces of the loop json data superset
SELECT 
    json->'generic'->>'locale' AS locale,
    json->'generic'->>'core_version' AS core_version,
    json->'user'->>'total_users' AS total_users
FROM 
    read_json('/local/s3/2023-11-14/*.json', ignore_errors=1) as json;","cellId":7,"useDatabase":"loop-duckdb"},{"query":"-- query only a some of the pieces of the loop json data superset into a persistent table
-- requires only the 'CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE generic_data AS' before the select statement
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE generic_data AS
SELECT 
    json->'generic'->>'locale' AS locale,
    json->'generic'->>'core_version' AS core_version,
    json->'user'->>'total_users' AS total_users
FROM 
    read_json('/local/s3/2023-11-14/*.json', ignore_errors=1) as json;","cellId":8,"useDatabase":"loop-duckdb"},{"query":"-- query loop json data superset and unnest the theme json array items to multiple rows
SELECT *, unnest(theme) as _theme
FROM read_json('/local/s3/2023-11-14/*.json', ignore_errors=1);
-- [Unnesting](https://duckdb.org/docs/stable/sql/query_syntax/unnest) is a powerful feature to 
-- See also https://duckdb.org/docs/stable/sql/query_syntax/unnest#unnesting-structs","cellId":9,"useDatabase":"loop-duckdb"},{"query":"-- query loop json data superset and unnest theme, plugin and post json array items to multiple rows
SELECT 
  generic, 
  user, 
  unnest(theme) as theme, 
  unnest(plugin) as plugins, 
  unnest(post) as posts,
  surveys,
  comment
FROM read_json('/local/s3/2023-11-14/*.json', ignore_errors=1);
","cellId":10,"useDatabase":"loop-duckdb"},{"query":"-- You can even unnest json properties recursively
SELECT 
  generic, 
  user, 
  unnest(theme) as theme, 
  unnest(plugin, recursive := true) as plugins, 
  unnest(post) as posts,
  surveys,
  comment
FROM read_json('/local/s3/2023-11-14/*.json', ignore_errors=1);","cellId":11,"useDatabase":"loop-duckdb"},{"query":"-- select everything `EXCEPT` some json properties from json loop data superset
SELECT
  * EXCLUDE (theme, plugin, post),
  unnest(theme) as theme, 
  unnest(plugin) as plugins, 
  unnest(post) as posts,
FROM read_json('/local/s3/2023-11-14/*.json', ignore_errors=1);
-- See https://duckdbsnippets.com/snippets/2/using-the-exclude-function-in-duckdb for more.","cellId":12,"useDatabase":"loop-duckdb"}],"currentDatabase":"loop-duckdb","viewMode":{"mode":"default"},"version":57,"notebookSerializationFormat":3}

json:
{"cells":[{"query":"-- 
-- select latest loop data unique for each customer and accumulate the installed plugins
--
WITH RecentLoops AS (
  SELECT
    file AS recent_loop_file
  FROM (
    SELECT
      *,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY instance ORDER BY "timestamp" DESC) as rn
    FROM
      loop_items
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
  p.plugin.plugin_slug,
  p.instance
FROM
  plugins AS p
JOIN
  RecentLoops AS rl
ON
  p.file = rl.recent_loop_file;","cellId":6,"useDatabase":"loop-duckdb"},{"query":"-- [real insight]
-- select latest loop data unique for each customer and accumulate the most active (used) plugins
--
WITH
  RecentLoops AS (
    SELECT
      file AS recent_loop_file
    FROM
      (
        SELECT
          *,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY
              instance
            ORDER BY
              "timestamp" DESC
          ) as rn
        FROM
          loop_items
      )
    WHERE
      rn = 1
  ),
  RecentPlugins AS (
    SELECT
      p.plugin.plugin_slug,
      p.instance,
      p.plugin.active
    FROM
      plugins AS p
      JOIN RecentLoops AS rl ON p.file = rl.recent_loop_file
  ),
  PluginCounts AS (
    -- Calculate the occurrence count for each plugin
    SELECT
      plugin_slug AS slug,
      COUNT(*) AS occurrence_count
    FROM
      RecentPlugins
    WHERE
      active = true -- OR active = false
    GROUP BY
      slug
  ),
  TotalCount AS (
    -- Calculate the total number of instances
    SELECT
      COUNT(*) AS total_instances
    FROM
      RecentLoops
  )
  -- Select the slug, its count, and the percentage of the total
SELECT
  pc.slug,
  pc.occurrence_count,
  (pc.occurrence_count * 100.0 / tc.total_instances) AS percentage
FROM
  PluginCounts AS pc,
  TotalCount AS tc
ORDER BY
  pc.occurrence_count DESC;","cellId":7,"useDatabase":"loop-duckdb"},{"query":"-- [real insight]
-- select latest loop data unique for each customer and accumulate the most active (used) themes
--
WITH
  RecentLoops AS (
    SELECT
      file AS recent_loop_file
    FROM
      (
        SELECT
          *,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY
              instance
            ORDER BY
              "timestamp" DESC
          ) as rn
        FROM
          loop_items
--        WHERE
--          plugin like '%"elementor"%'
      )
    WHERE
      rn = 1
  ),
  RecentThemes AS (
    SELECT
      t.theme.id,
      t.instance,
      t.theme.active
    FROM
      themes AS t
      JOIN RecentLoops AS rl ON t.file = rl.recent_loop_file
  ),
  ThemeCounts AS (
    -- Calculate the occurrence count for each theme
    SELECT
      id as slug,
      COUNT(*) AS occurrence_count
    FROM
      RecentThemes
    WHERE
      active = true -- OR active = false
    GROUP BY
      slug
  ),
  TotalCount AS (
    -- Calculate the total number of instances
    SELECT
      COUNT(*) AS total_instances
    FROM
      RecentLoops
  )
  -- Select the slug, its count, and the percentage of the total
SELECT
  pc.slug,
  pc.occurrence_count,
  (pc.occurrence_count * 100.0 / tc.total_instances) AS percentage
FROM
  ThemeCounts AS pc,
  TotalCount AS tc
ORDER BY
  pc.occurrence_count DESC;","cellId":8,"useDatabase":"loop-duckdb","isActive":true}],"currentDatabase":"loop-duckdb","viewMode":{"mode":"default"},"version":295,"notebookSerializationFormat":3}
